Founder website design package

Yes, this is the package for founders who want a fully owned web or app site built fast. You get a custom design, all code and content, and you keep the domain without any monthly hosting fee.

How it works for a founder launching a SaaS MVP

  1. Pay a 50 % deposit.
  2. Everbuilt Studio designs and builds your site (up to unlimited sections, admin panel, integrations).
  3. You review the draft, request any tweaks, and approve the launch.
  4. The site goes live in about a week, and you own everything outright.

What you get and the cost

  • Signature package – starts at $7,500.
  • Unlimited sections, galleries, spreadsheet‑driven events, email and form integrations.
  • 90 days of free post‑launch care; optional care plans afterwards at $295/month or $595/month, cancel anytime.
  • Hosting is $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.
  • All code, content, and domain remain yours.

FAQ

Do I have to pay ongoing fees for the site? No. After the optional care plan you may cancel at any time. The site itself has zero hosting cost.

How long does the build take? The typical timeline is about a week from deposit to launch, as described in the website‑in‑a‑week guide.

What if I need changes after launch? You receive 90 days of free care, during which you can request adjustments at no extra charge.

What if I’m not satisfied with the design? You can start with a free homepage remake (details). If you don’t like it, you keep the design and pay nothing else.

Can I add e‑commerce or app features later? Yes. The Platform package starts at $15K for full web apps, SaaS MVPs, or mobile apps.

Ready to own a founder‑focused website that launches quickly? Start your founder website design package
